title: Indian Parliament Meeting Turns Violent
summary: A high-voltage drama unfolded at a parliamentary meeting, where a group of TMC MPs walked out in protest. The incident occurred ahead of the monsoon session, which is expected to be crucial for the government's agenda. The opposition has been critical of the government's handling of the situation, while some have questioned how the debate will proceed without the absent MPs.
summary_points: A group of TMC MPs walked out of a parliamentary meeting in protest
The incident occurred ahead of the monsoon session, which is expected to be crucial for the government's agenda
The opposition has been critical of the government's handling of the situation
Some have questioned how the debate will proceed without the absent MPs
The walkout has added to the tension in the lead-up to the monsoon session

framing.right: Right-leaning outlets focus on the drama and violence that unfolded during the meeting, as well as the TMC MPs' walkout. They often frame the opposition's actions as provocative or disruptive.
